# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

Please follow the core project guidelines and architecture defined in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the canonical rules under [docs/guidelines/](../docs/guidelines/).

## Key Reminders

- Refer to `docs/guidelines/workflow.md`, `docs/guidelines/testing.md`, and `docs/guidelines/review-comment-format.md` as the Single Source of Truth for development rules.
- Refer to skills in `.github/skills/` for multi-step AI workflows and orchestration.
- Refer to custom agents in `.github/agents/` for independent PR review (`pr-reviewer`) and milestone final review (`phase-final-reviewer`).
